adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` the new loop over `calendarReference` performs a DB lookup when `reference.credentialId` is set, but if the credential is not found in `this.calendarCredentials` *and* the DB lookup returns null/doesn’t yield `app.slug`, the code still unconditionally calls `updateEvent(credential, event, ...)` where `credential` can remain `undefined` (no guard before `result.push(updateEvent(...))`). This is a concrete runtime correctness issue exposed by the diff; the “untested” part isn’t verifiable from the diff, but the undefined-credential call is.
